source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 ноября ст. ст. — «Свт. Григория , архиеп. Александрийского (ок. 813-820).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 5 noiembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie, Arhiepiscopul Alexandriei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Γρηγόριος ο Ομολογητής Πάπας Αλεξανδρείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: ordained to Alexandria by the bishops gathered after the death of its patriarch, and exiled for resisting the emperor Leo's revival of iconoclasm. The page ends with a caution of its own: «Σημείωση: Δυστυχώς στους πατριαρχικούς καταλόγους δεν καταφέραμε να βρούμε κάποιον Γρηγόριο που να έζησε την εποχή του Λέοντα Ε' (813 - 820 μ.Χ.)» — it could not find in the patriarchal lists a Gregory living in the time of Leo V. That doubt is the page's own and is quoted rather than resolved here; no `dates` object is proposed on the strength of a century the page itself cannot place. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

death.note: The interval days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «(ок. 813-820)». The page does not say whether the years are his death, his episcopate or the reign he lived under, and it gives him no life page at all, so the interval is recorded as it stands and nothing is read into it. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
